message:
The parts connect end to end at the midspan antinode, Structural Dynamicist, Bridge Retrofit Engineer, Pedestrian Comfort and Safety Assessor, Retrofit Integration and Construction Lead. In plain words the bridge motion drives the masses where motion is largest and the frame carries the push into the girders with nothing on the deck. The clamp-on cross-beam suspension (C19) hands relative motion as mechanical energy to the twin Tuned Mass Damper, defined as Tuned Mass Damper (TMD), pair (C20) at the same midspan station, the paired dampers (C21) share that travel inside each unit as heat plus reduced motion, the High-Strength Friction-Grip, defined as High-Strength Friction-Grip (HSFG), clamped cross-beam (C22) carries weight plus dynamic shear into the girder webs, the caged stops (C23) catch the same travel in the same cage, containment (C24) envelopes all steel within girder depth, and the crowd acceptance run (C29) takes acceleration as signal from the same antinode.

The numbers fit everyday feel and limits with reconciled values, Structural Dynamicist, Bridge Retrofit Engineer, Pedestrian Comfort and Safety Assessor, Retrofit Integration and Construction Lead. In plain words added weight is about one person against a hundred, bare shake is near body weight while damped shake is a small fraction, and motion fits in a hand. Added weight 7.85 kN from the static-weight calculation (E26) is 1.31 percent of 600 kN live load from the live-load estimate (E30) in the weight-fraction calculation (E72) and meets the 2 percent rule, keeping modal stiffness 2.85 MN per m from the modal-stiffness calculation (E12) and dropping the early 4.28 MN per m estimate (E9), retrofitted 0.668 m/s2 from the retrofitted-acceleration calculation (E44) settling at 0.67 m/s2 in the crowd build-up simulation (E45) is 0.068 g inside Medium 0.5 to 1.0 m/s2 versus bare 8.28 m/s2 from the bare-acceleration calculation (E43) at 0.844 g outside feel, travel 49.4 mm from the free-decay simulation (E17) clears in 80 mm stops with sag 74.7 mm from the static-sag calculation (E63) totalling 124 mm from the envelope calculation (E68) inside girder depth per the layout sketch (E55), and clamp 32.9 kN slip per bolt from the slip-resistance calculation (E64) exceeds 13.1 kN demand from the combined-load calculation (E65) with 8.40 kN stop hit from the stop-force calculation (E66).

There are no open blocking objections and prior not-ready votes are answered by selections but need fresh votes on this version, Structural Dynamicist, Bridge Retrofit Engineer, Pedestrian Comfort and Safety Assessor, Retrofit Integration and Construction Lead. In plain words tuning, steel weight, comfort level and twin units are carried into choice while access and clamp upkeep still need confirmation. I hold Medium comfort as target per the comfort-target concept (C13) with detuning holding 0.476 to 0.526 m/s2 from the detuning sweep (E70) and off-antinode penalty 0.750 from the modal-effectiveness calculation (E67) confirming midspan grouping, and I correct the 0.133 percent fraction (E71) as kilograms over newtons and keep 1.31 percent (E72).

RECORD: Decided twin 400 kg TMD at 1.83 Hz 12.0 percent on HSFG clamped cross-beam at midspan within girder depth with 80 mm stops and crowd acceptance run, numbers that stand are 800 kg total (E13) 7.85 kN (E26) 1.31 percent (E72) 1.83 Hz (E14) 12.0 percent (E15) 6.20 percent effective (E17) 0.67 m/s2 versus 8.28 m/s2 (E45)(E43) 49.4 mm 80 mm 74.7 mm 124 mm (E17)(E63)(E68) 32.9 kN versus 13.1 kN plus 8.40 kN (E64)(E65)(E66), still open are votes on proposal v1 by all members plus access-route lock by Retrofit Integration and Construction Lead and clamp preload upkeep by Bridge Retrofit Engineer with stop-into-beam check.
Note on Structural Dynamicist: tight tune with detuning proof carried into twin choice.
Note on Bridge Retrofit Engineer: stiffening ruled out and slip margin shown, upkeep still owed.
Note on Pedestrian Comfort and Safety Assessor: Medium target with simulation proof accepted, fresh vote owed.
Note on Retrofit Integration and Construction Lead: twin buildability and envelope shown, access lock still owed.
My position is not ready, because votes on proposal v1 and access plus upkeep confirmations are still open.
